_readme: MODEL BAN LIST: animagine-xl-4.0, NoobAI-XL-v1.1, wai-illustrious-v110, z-anime-distill, FLUX.1-Krea-dev.

scene_plate.json.purpose: Location master plate - background consistency anchor
scene_plate.json.note: SDXL-only. GGUF port pending. Use image_krea2.json or panel_txt2img_krea.json instead.

panel_txt2img.json.purpose: Per-shot panel: base + speed LoRA + style LoRA + character LoRAs + IPAdapter
panel_txt2img.json.note: SDXL-only. GGUF port pending. Use image_krea2.json or panel_txt2img_krea.json instead.

panel_img2img_lastframe.json.purpose: Block-opening shot conditioned on previous block's last frame
panel_img2img_lastframe.json.note: SDXL-only. GGUF port pending. Use image_krea2.json or panel_txt2img_krea.json instead.

ltx22b_i2v.json.purpose: LTX 2.3 22B Q4 image-to-video (panel start frame). Validated 768x448x81f ~55s @ 5.8GB VRAM with LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode.

wan_ti2v_visual.json.purpose: Visual workflow for ComfyUI browser (load via Load button)

image_krea2_controlnet.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo txt2img with LoRA support (simplified for pipeline use)
image_krea2_controlnet.json.note: Basic Krea2 txt2img with LoRA loading capability. ControlNet preprocessing nodes not available in current ComfyUI installation.

image_krea2_edit.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo img2img with LoRA support (simplified for pipeline use)
image_krea2_edit.json.note: Basic Krea2 img2img using VAEEncode of source image + LoRA. Krea2EditModelPatch nodes not available in current ComfyUI installation.

character_turnaround_sheet.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo GGUF character reference sheet (portrait orientation, 832x1216). Replaces deprecated SDXL version.
character_turnaround_sheet.json.note: GGUF port 2026-07-28. Uses UnetLoaderGGUF + CLIPLoader + VAELoader. CFG-distilled (cfg=1.0, ConditioningZeroOut neg).

mouth_viseme_sheet.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo GGUF inpaint mouth viseme shapes (replaces deprecated SDXL version)
mouth_viseme_sheet.json.note: GGUF port 2026-07-28. Uses UnetLoaderGGUF + CLIPLoader + VAELoader + VAEEncodeForInpaint. Denoise 0.65 for face preservation.

image_flux_fallback_txt2img.json.purpose: FLUX schnell GGUF fallback image generation

image_anima_txt2img.json.purpose: Anima 1.0 standalone txt2img (anime-tuned panel/plate model). Full safetensors via UNETLoader + qwen3_06b CLIP + qwen_image_vae.
image_anima_txt2img.json.note: Official recipe (image_anima_base_v1 blueprint): er_sde/simple, 30 steps, cfg 4.0, real text negative (NOT cfg-distilled like krea2). DENOISE 1.0 txt2img.

panel_krea2_img2img_plate.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo reference-first panel: IMG2IMG redraw of the scene's location master plate (denoise<1.0), compositing the character sd_prompt onto a locked background. Style-lock via img2img (no IPAdapter/LoRA needed). NOW USES KREA2 NATIVE VAE (qwen_image_vae) for 768x448 resolution. ControlNet, Style LoRA, ColorCorrect, Regional Prompts, Mask nodes removed for 8GB VRAM testing.
panel_krea2_img2img_plate.json.note: Same krea2 GGUF recipe as image_krea2_txt2img.json but the KSampler latent is VAEEncode(plate) instead of an empty latent. PLATE_IMG is the ComfyUI-registered filename after comfy.upload_image(). DENOISE default 0.2 (tighter plate lock); lower = harder background lock. ControlNet, Style LoRA, ColorCorrect, Regional Prompts, Mask nodes removed for 8GB VRAM testing.

panel_anima_img2img_plate.json.purpose: Anima 1.0 reference-first panel: IMG2IMG redraw of the scene location plate (denoise<1.0). Anime-tuned faces/eyes on LTX VAE locked background. Style-lock via img2img. ControlNet, Style LoRA, ColorCorrect, Regional Prompts nodes removed for 8GB VRAM testing.
panel_anima_img2img_plate.json.note: Same plate-lock design as panel_krea2_img2img_plate.json but Anima recipe (er_sde/30/cfg 4.0) and real negative. DENOISE default 0.2; lower = harder background lock. ControlNet, Style LoRA, ColorCorrect, Regional Prompts nodes removed for 8GB VRAM testing.

video_ltx2b_i2v.json.purpose: LTX-2 2B I2V (ltxv-2b-0.9.8-distilled-fp8-i2v, T5-XXL text encoder). Self-contained on 8GB VRAM. Real motion and proper contrast at 768x448x81f@16fps.
video_ltx2b_i2v.json.note: PATCHED 2026-08-07: switched from the broken gemma-3-12b+patched-connector (caption_channels 3840, flat mush output std~11) to T5-XXL encoder + original un-patched model (caption_channels 4096). Fixes: (1) decode via bundled VAE (port 2) not LTX23 VAE; (2) distinct T5-XL negative prompt node 5; (3) KSamplerSelect euler_ancestral_cfg_pp. std went 11->59, bright% 0->19.4. No gemma cold-load needed (T5-XXL is fast).

video_ltx23_i2v.json.purpose: LTX 2.3 22B GGUF Q4 I2V fallback (8GB VRAM with --lowvram)

video_wan_i2v.json.purpose: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B I2V comparison path (same panel start frame as ltx2b_i2v). VAE-encode start frame -> WanVideoEmptyEmbeds extra_latent -> WanVideoSampler.
video_wan_i2v.json.note: PATCHED 2026-08-07: unipc 30 steps (was 20), cfg 4.0->5.0, VAE tiling OFF on both WanVideoEncode and WanVideoDecode (was 272x272 tiles with 144/128 strides — tile seams were causing fuzzy/shaky output). Same fp8 5B model + umt5-xxl. Measured: sharpness 15.4->16.3 (+5.8%), std 62.1->63.5, dark% 5.0->4.8, temporal std 2.52->3.35 (still smooth).

video_wan_t2v.json.purpose: WanVideo 2.2 T2V: 5B GGUF Q4_K_M, 30 steps unipc, block-swap 20, cfg 5.0, 81f@16fps
video_wan_t2v.json.notes: T2V mode only (5B model lacks I2V cross-attn weights). Verified 480x320 on 8GB VRAM.

pipeline_full_graph.json.purpose: Master end-to-end visual graph: scene plate (3B) + panel txt2img (3B) + LTX-2.3 i2v animation (3C) + video combine — all in one loadable ComfyUI workflow
pipeline_full_graph.json.note: All 31 nodes verified against ComfyUI object_info (2026-08-05). All 7 model files verified on disk. Load via UI Load button. Patchable points: PROMPT_POS_PANEL, PROMPT_POS_PLATE, MOTION_PROMPT, START_FRAME, SEED, WIDTH, HEIGHT, SAVE_PREFIX.

lora_dataset_prep_old.json.purpose: WD14 captioning of ref images for LoRA datasets

lora_caption_wd14.json.purpose: LoRA training dataset captioning (single image) using WD14 Tagger. Anime-friendly danbooru-style tags. Requires wd-v1-4-moat-tagger-v2 in ComfyUI/models/taggers/.
lora_caption_wd14.json.note: Use for character LoRAs that need danbooru-style tag captions (e.g. '1girl, red_hair, school_uniform'). For natural-language captions use lora_caption_qwen3.json instead.

lora_caption_qwen3.json.purpose: LoRA training dataset captioning (single image) using Qwen3-VL. Natural-language sentence captions. Requires Qwen3-VL text encoder in ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/.
lora_caption_qwen3.json.note: Use for character/location/style LoRAs that need sentence captions (e.g. 'a photo of a young woman with red hair standing in a mountain shrine at sunset'). 4-bit quantization for 8GB VRAM.

lora_dataset_batch.json.purpose: LoRA training dataset captioning (batch from directory) using WD14 Tagger + save .txt per image.
lora_dataset_batch.json.note: Loads all images from a folder via VHS_LoadImagesPath, runs WD14 tagger, saves .txt caption file per image via SaveStringKJ. Use for batch-preparing character/location/style LoRA datasets.

lora_caption_qwen3_batch.json.purpose: LoRA training dataset captioning (batch from directory) using Qwen3-VL + save .txt per image. Natural-language sentence captions.
lora_caption_qwen3_batch.json.note: Batch folder version of lora_caption_qwen3.json — loads all images from a folder and emits .txt captions via SaveStringKJ. Use for batch character/location/style LoRA dataset prep when you want natural-language captions instead of danbooru tags.

master_pipeline_graph.json.purpose: Master end-to-end visual graph: scene plate (3B) + panel txt2img (3B) + LTX-2.3 i2v animation (3C) + video combine — all in one loadable ComfyUI workflow
master_pipeline_graph.json.note: Combined stage3b + stage3c visual graph. Load via UI Load button.

panel_krea2_ipadapter.json.purpose: Krea-2-Turbo reference-first panel with identity/style IPAdapters: IMG2IMG redraw of scene plate + character identity IPAdapter + style IPAdapter. Replaces the _count_clause prompt trick with native krea2 identity/style locking. Requires krea2-compatible IPAdapter models (16-channel Qwen-Image latent space).
panel_krea2_ipadapter.json.note: EXPERIMENTAL: Requires krea2-compatible IPAdapter models for 16-channel Qwen-Image latent space. All IPAdapter strengths default to 0.0 (bypassed) so workflow functions as standard plate-lock img2img when IPAdapters unavailable.

video_hailuo_i2v.json.purpose: Hailuo 2.3 (MiniMax H3) image-to-video workflow for panel animation. Optional API or local ComfyUI path.

panel_krea2_ref.json.purpose: (Legacy alias) Krea-2-Turbo reference-first panel with identity/style IPAdapters (moved to panel_krea2_ipadapter.json)
panel_krea2_ref.json.note: Renamed to panel_krea2_ipadapter.json on 2026-08-11. This entry kept for backwards-compat lookups only.
